# Anne Shirley & Josephine Barry

The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P16](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0016), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P25](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0025)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious because [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) was accidentally served currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) fails to convince Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) that it was an honest mistake, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) herself to beg for forgiveness, but Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) coldly rejects her. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to sleep, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tenderly kisses her after laughing over the incident with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to let her attend a concert and sleep over at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at Diana's house, accidentally jumping on Diana's formidable [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who is enraged. Learning from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) plans to leave and cancel Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply remorseful for causing trouble.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> After speaking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to confess to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her in the spare-room bed. Anne's candid apology and imaginative conversation charm the old lady, prompting her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), extend her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and become close friends with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) Pye's challenge to walk the ridgepole of the kitchen roof, but she loses her balance and falls. She breaks her ankle in the fall, which causes [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and looks forward to returning to school to meet the new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

> Following the excitement of the concert, school routines resume alongside minor classroom feuds. Walking to school on her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her story writing and imagination with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later establishes a story club with her friends and shares her enthusiasm and stories with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in Lover's Lane to share the news that her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) has invited them to stay at her town home for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting Marilla's permission, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) travel to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) with Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), stay at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), and enjoy several days visiting the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), taking a drive in the park, and attending a concert. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects happily on her wonderful trip and how good it is to be going back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid goodbye to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who reflects fondly on Anne's pleasant company. The girls enjoy a beautiful sunset drive back home, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warmly reunites with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) over supper.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), leading to an emotional farewell at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Upon arriving in town and starting her studies alongside fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students, she settles into her new boarding house. A visit from [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and Ruby reveals news of an Avery scholarship, inspiring [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with ambitious new goals for her future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming close friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while maintaining her academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She enjoys visits home and time spent with Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). As spring arrives and final examinations approach, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects philosophically on her efforts while discussing the upcoming exams and commencement with her friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After a celebratory commencement with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and catches up with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Soon after, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) notices Matthew's failing health, learns from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about their savings being tied up in a shaky bank, and shares a quiet, peaceful evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) excitedly prepare [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and a grand dinner for the guest of honor, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies, the guest of honor fails to arrive, and the dinner suffers from cooking mishaps and damaged property. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later receives a letter explaining Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, making sense of the day's disappointment.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents
